prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Quick key shortcuts and right-click actions let you interact with your pet anytime on your screen.", "Press Alt+P to instantly show or hide your companion", "Right-click your companion on desktop for quick command menu", "Got It"]
1: ["Customize & Preview Your Companion", "Select dynamic traits and test voice lines in real time before adopting.", "Personality Trait & Voice Studio"]
2: []
3: ["Find Your Ideal Companion Path", "Answer two quick questions so we can match you with the right creation workflow.", "How would you like your companion to look on screen?", "See Recommendation"]
4: ["Signing in syncs your account and restores any previously created desktop pets safely.", "Cloud Pet Sync & Restoration Active"]
5: ["Verifying desktop overlay permissions and screen rendering support"]
6: ["Your Desktop Companion is Live!", "Look for your pet on your desktop screen or in the system tray. Right-click the tray icon anytime to customize settings or hide.", "Launch Companion"]
7: ["Complete your adoption now to unlock an exclusive Founder Collar accessory!", "Bonus Unlocked: Exclusive Founder Collar"]
8: ["Play completion notification chime when asset render finishes"]
9: ["Welcome to Your AI Desktop Companion", "Create a living, reactive pet that lives directly on your desktop."]

verdicts.problem: Creates urgency and offers exclusive bonuses or free extras to push adoption.
